payload.name: Preserve Prior Facts When Updating Memory
payload.description: Apply during CRUD when a new message adds a detail to an existing preference, state, or profile memory, to avoid replacing older supported facts with a narrower statement.
content: During CRUD, before UPDATE or MERGE, compare the new evidence with the stored content. If the new fact is additional rather than contradictory, preserve the old facts and append the new detail instead of overwriting the whole memory.
Use MERGE or an additive UPDATE when the prior facts are still supported by earlier messages; do not rewrite the memory to only the new detail.
Do not mark the memory as a correction or change its kind/start date unless the source message explicitly states the previous fact was wrong or no longer true.

solves: When later information adds a new detail to an existing memory, the Construction Agent sometimes overwrites the entire memory with the new detail, losing previously supported facts. This skill prevents that by requiring the agent to preserve old facts unless the new evidence explicitly contradicts them.
